meta.title: Sideline Padel
meta.description: Log your matches, follow your progress and arrange games with players at your level.

landing.heroSubtitle: Log every match, watch your level evolve, and find people to play with near you.

features.trackBody: Every match counts. Win rate, streaks, level progression and who you played with.
features.levelBody: You declare your category and the community weighs in. Your matchmaking level comes from both.
features.matchBody: Post that you need players, or join someone else's game. With a reminder before you play.

disclaimer.noBooking: Sideline does not book courts. Book with your club, then post the game once you have it.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be broken or the page has moved.
errors.genericBody: Please try again in a moment.

auth.title: Sign in to Sideline
auth.subtitle: No passwords. We'll email you a link.
auth.checkInboxBody: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 15 minutes.
auth.legal: By signing in you accept the terms and the privacy policy.
auth.minAge: You must be 16 or older to use Sideline.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't send the link. Please try again.
errors.missing_code: That link is incomplete. Request a new one.
errors.invalid_code: That link expired or was already used. Request a new one.

name.title: What's your name?
name.subtitle: This is how other players will see you.
name.label: First and last name

birth.title: When were you born?
birth.subtitle: Only used to check the minimum age. Never shown to anyone.
birth.label: Date of birth

country.title: Where are you from?
country.subtitle: Sets your flag and how your category is displayed.
country.label: Country

game.title: How do you play?
game.subtitle: Your dominant hand and the side you're comfortable on.

level.title: What's your level?
level.subtitle: Be honest: you can change it later, and the community weighs in too.
level.communityNote: As you play, the people you share a court with will rate your level. Your declaration and those ratings combine into the level we use to match you.
